description.en: Create a new GitHub repository with labels, branch protection, and initial issues
description.de: Neues GitHub-Repository erstellen mit Labels, Branch-Protection und initialen Issues

instructions: Erstelle ein neues GitHub-Repository mit Standardkonfiguration. Variablen: repo_name, visibility (public/private), org (Organisation oder 'none').

config.command:
set -euo pipefail
VIS="{{ visibility }}"
ORG="{{ org }}"
REPO="{{ repo_name }}"
if [ -n "$ORG" ] && [ "$ORG" != "none" ]; then
  gh repo create "$ORG/$REPO" --"$VIS" --clone
else
  gh repo create "$REPO" --"$VIS" --clone
fi
cd "$REPO"
git commit --allow-empty -m "Initial commit"
git push -u origin main
echo "Repository created: $(gh repo view --json url -q .url)"

set -euo pipefail
cd "{{ repo_name }}"
NAME="$(echo '{{ label }}' | cut -d: -f1)"
COLOR="$(echo '{{ label }}' | cut -d: -f2)"
gh label create "$NAME" --color "$COLOR" --force
echo "Label created: $NAME"

set -euo pipefail
cd {{ repo_name }}
gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/branches/main/protection \
  --method PUT \
  --input - <<'JSON'
{
  "required_pull_request_reviews": { "required_approving_review_count": 1 },
  "enforce_admins": false,
  "required_status_checks": null,
  "restrictions": null
}
JSON
echo "Branch protection enabled on main"

set -euo pipefail
cd "{{ repo_name }}"
gh issue create --title "Project setup" --body "- [ ] Add README\n- [ ] Configure CI/CD\n- [ ] Add .gitignore\n- [ ] Set up linting" --label "good-first-issue"
gh issue create --title "Add contributing guidelines" --body "Add CONTRIBUTING.md with development workflow and coding standards." --label "documentation"
echo "Initial issues created"
